direction: Side-scrolling fantasy brawler inspired by classic combo-driven action games with fluid chaining, beautiful chi blasts, attractive heroes, and premium UI presentation
visual_differentiation_axes: character-stage menu composition instead of centered utility menu cards
crest-cluster vitals and free-floating combo bloom rather than top pill HUD plus bottom strip
midnight lacquer fantasy martial palette with cyan chi and ember gold accents
dragon-arc hero punch icon silhouette rather than generic sword or shield emblem
strict playfield-safe framing that keeps ornate chrome outside the live combat lane
forbidden_visual_reuse: do not reuse generic top HUD pills with a bottom command strip
do not use a plain centered menu panel over a static backdrop
do not reuse a castle badge, shield crest, or generic sword icon concept
do not cover the combat lane with decorative bezels or thick borders
do not reuse another project's unchanged dark fantasy palette composition

ui_identity.layout_archetype: upper-left crest vitals cluster, upper-right combo bloom, lower-corner control halos, and chapter-stage menu with layered right-side cards
ui_identity.hud_composition: stacked life and chi crest module, transient style rank bloom, slim top-center objective banner, conditional boss strip, and corner-anchored touch controls
ui_identity.navigation_model: main menu hero stage to horizontal chapter cards, then route-node stage select with slide-over upgrade and codex panels
ui_identity.palette_signature: midnight navy and black lacquer base with cyan energy highlights, ember gold trims, and restrained crimson danger accents
ui_identity.material_language: polished lacquer panels, etched metal trims, translucent energy glass, slash-brush separators, and medallion crests
ui_identity.typography_style: angular heroic display headers with condensed readable secondary labels

playfield_safety.frame_overlay_policy: menu and result frames may be ornate, but gameplay chrome must stop outside protected combat zones and retract fully after scripted boss intros

unique_screen_motifs: hero spotlight stage on main menu
boss warning banner that tears open then retracts
forbidden_ui_elements: generic rounded mobile pills across the top

icon_identity.subject: the main hero delivering a forward dragon-chi punch
icon_identity.silhouette: diagonal striking forearm with a sweeping dragon-energy arc wrapping one side of the frame
icon_identity.composition: three-quarter hero close-up with the punch breaking toward camera and the dragon-energy tail framing the face
icon_identity.palette: cyan chi core, ember gold sparks, deep navy shadows, and small crimson contrast notes
icon_identity.background: dark stormy gradient or lacquered night backdrop with subtle radial burst
icon_identity.game_specific_motif: dragon-shaped chi arc emerging from the hero's strike
forbidden_icon_reuse: copied icon silhouette from prior fantasy projects
